verdict.rationale: An email/productivity platform with public developer docs could reasonably publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies. Direct probes found no llms.txt (404), no markdown versions of doc pages (404), and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path (404). The existing Microsoft Graph mail docs are conventional human-oriented API references, which do not count as agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
